def policy(obs, P):
    x = obs[0]
    v = obs[1]
    th = obs[2]
    om = obs[3]
    if x < P['x_thr']:
        return 1
    score = P['w_x']*x + P['w_v']*v + P['w_th']*th + P['w_om']*om + P['b']
    return 1 if score > 0 else 0
